name: animated-beam
title: Animated Beam
description: A light that flows along a curved path between two elements, for integration diagrams. Holds a still path under reduced motion and pauses off screen.

props.name: containerRef
props.description: The positioned element the SVG is laid over.

props.name: curvature
props.description: How far the path bows away from a straight line, in pixels. Negative bows the other way.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Runs the beam from toRef back to fromRef.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one pass of the light.

props.name: pathWidth
props.description: Stroke width of the path and the beam.

props.name: pathOpacity
props.description: Opacity of the resting path under the beam.

props.name: gradientFrom
props.description: Color at the head of the beam.

props.name: gradientTo
props.description: Color at the tail of the beam.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops the light; only the resting path stays.
